title: Apple refreshes its Homepod mini with a new chip and $149 price tag
summary: Apple is refreshing its HomePod mini with a new chip and 'SoundGlow' visual feature that syncs LED lights with music. The device will launch October 30 at $149, featuring Siri AI integration.
content: The new $149 HomePod mini with Siri AI and a 'SoundGlow' visual feature will be available starting October 30.

title: Apple’s new smart home line-up includes a smart lock, thermostat and video doorbells

content: The new devices work with HomeView, the company's new smart home hub which can be used to control accessories and interact with apps.

title: Where to preorder the new Apple TV 4K
summary: Apple's new Apple TV 4K, its first refresh in four years, launches November 13 with the A19 chip and improved wireless connectivity. The $299 device features Siri AI support and Find My tracking capability.
content:
Apple debuted its latest Apple TV 4K - its first in four years - and it'll be available starting Friday, November 13th. It's powerful, with the A19 chip (the now-discontinued 2022 model has the A15 Bionic), and it features better wireless connectivity than its predecessor, too. Siri AI is a big part of this rollout, though it'll work in beta on the second-gen Apple TV 4K models and newer. The new Find My tracking feature works with the second-gen Siri remote and newer.
It's not cheap, costing $299 (twice the original cost of the 2022 Apple TV 4K, until it rose to $249 a few months ago), but those who've been waiting a while for a new versio …

title: India delays digital payments fee rollout amid retailer pushback
summary: India's NPCI has postponed the planned October 15 rollout of a 0.4% UPI transaction fee following retailer pushback during the festive shopping season. The delay addresses concerns about increased costs for small merchants.
content: The NPCI, which operates the UPI network, said it was postponing the planned October 15 rollout of the 0.4% fee due to the festive shopping season.

zh.title: 印度在零售商反对声中延迟数字支付费用推出
zh.summary: 印度国家支付公司(NPCI)在零售商在节日购物季的反对声中，延迟了原定10月15日推出的0.4% UPI交易费。这一延迟解决了小商户成本增加的担忧。

title: Apple launches a new Apple TV 4K with Siri AI and remote-free voice commands
summary: Apple has announced the new Apple TV 4K for $299, launching November 13 with integrated Siri AI voice assistant and hands-free remote-free voice commands. The device marks Apple's push into AI-powered home entertainment.
content: The new Apple TV 4K costs $299, comes with Siri AI, and will be available on November 13.

content: Apple is taking a big swing at the smart home market with its latest product that competes with Amazon Echo Show and Google Nest Hub.

title: Watch Apple’s reveal video for the HomeView
summary: Apple announced the HomeView smart display during its "Welcome Home" event, a 7-inch square device priced at $299 available in wall-mount or speaker-base versions. The hub serves as a Matter controller, Thread Border Router, and supports Siri AI, video calls, and HomeKit Secure Video.
content:
Apple just announced its long-rumored smart home hub, the HomeView, during its "Welcome Home" event taking place today. As part of the event, it showed a video featuring the new device, and if you want to see it for yourself, you can watch it right here.
The HomeView is a 7-inch square display. It costs $299 and comes in two versions: one that mounts to a wall, and another that sits atop a small speaker base. It can be used to show smart home controls, pull up information with Siri AI, take video calls, and show footage from HomeKit Secure Video cameras. It's also a Matter controller and a Thread Border Router.

title: Getty Images is going private after failed Shutterstock merger
summary: Getty Images is going private through a prepackaged Chapter 11 bankruptcy after its merger with Shutterstock fell through, securing $533 million from the Getty family and Koch Industries. The restructuring is expected to complete by year-end with minimal stakeholder impact.
content:
Getty Images intends to file for bankruptcy and go private as part of a restructuring agreement after its plans to merge with rival stock platform Shutterstock fell through earlier this year. On Monday, Getty announced it had secured $533 million from the Getty family and Charles Koch's investment firm to cut its debt and take the company private, outlining plans to undergo a prepackaged Chapter 11 process "in the coming weeks."
The restructuring effort is expected to be wrapped up by the end of this year, with no anticipated impact on content contributors, partners, customers, or employees globally. Once completed, the company will be enti …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Getty Images 在与 Shutterstock 合并失败后将私有化
zh.summary: Getty Images 通过预打包破产第 11 章在与 Shutterstock 的合并失败后将私有化，从盖蒂家族和科赫工业获得了 5.33 亿美元。预计这项重组将在年底前完成，对利益相关者的影响最小。

title: Amex introduces a framework to prevent AI agents from making unauthorized purchases
summary: American Express has introduced a framework to prevent AI agents from making unauthorized purchases on behalf of users. The safeguard addresses growing risks as AI-powered commerce expands.
content: American Express is introducing a new framework designed to ensure AI agents only make purchases their users have authorized, potentially preventing costly mistakes and disputes as AI-powered shopping grows.

title: The new Apple TV 4K has built-in microphones so you can talk to Siri AI
summary: Apple's fourth-generation Apple TV 4K introduces far-field microphones for hands-free Siri AI commands and Find My tracking in the remote, launching November 13 for $299. The device supports pairing up to four HomePod speakers for surround sound.
content:
Apple TV 4K (4th gen) has the same look as the previous model but with some under-the-hood improvements. | Image: Apple	

Apple is introducing a refreshed Apple TV 4K today with a pair of interesting new hardware features: far-field microphones to talk to Siri hands-free and Find My built into the remote. The fourth-gen Apple TV 4K, announced at Apple's Welcome Home event in New York City, is the first model to support the Siri AI voice assistant and has a new home theatre feature that lets you pair up to four second-gen HomePods or HomePod Mini 2s for surround sound.

title: Apple announces the HomePod Mini 2, but it isn’t ready for Siri AI at launch
summary: Apple announced the HomePod Mini 2 with a new chip supporting Siri AI capabilities, though the feature won't be available at launch. The $149 speaker adds a SoundGlow LED feature and can pair with the new Apple TV 4K for surround sound.
content:
The HomePod Mini 2. | Image: Apple	

Apple is announcing the long-awaited HomePod Mini 2 with a new chip that can power Siri AI - but support for those new AI features won't be available at launch. The speaker is also getting a new sound glow feature that syncs its LED lights with a song's album art, and it can now be your Mac's default speaker. Up to four can also pair with the new Apple TV 4K for surround sound. And like everything this year, it's more expensive, too.

title: The new Apple Home Collection includes a video doorbell, smart lock, and more
summary: Apple has partnered with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric to launch the Apple Home Collection, a starter kit of smart home devices including security cameras, video doorbell, door lock, and thermostats. This marks Apple's first internally developed smart home hardware.
content:
The Apple Home Collection includes a door lock, security cameras, thermostats, and home sensors. | Image: Apple	

Apple has partnered with LG Electronics and Schneider Electric to launch the Apple Home Collection, an assortment of smart home devices meant to be easy to set up and use. The collection is something of a smart home starter pack, including security cameras, a video doorbell, a door lock, and two thermostats.
Apple is announcing the products as part of a major push into the smart home space, led by its new Siri AI-powered HomeView smart display. The devices are the first smart home gadgets the company has made for Apple Home; previously, it relied on third parties to make products for the platform. title: Apple launches HomeView, its first smart display for the home
summary: Apple has launched the HomeView, a compact 7-inch smart display priced at $299 with Siri AI, video calling, and photo display in wall-mount or speaker-base configurations. The device's square design positions it as less imposing than competing smart displays.
content:
The HomeView is a smart speaker with a touchscreen display. It’s available in silver, starlight, rose pink, and space gray. | Image: Apple	

It's finally here: Apple's long-rumored smart display, the Apple HomeView, has arrived. I got a first look at the device in New York City this week, and it's gorgeous. The HomeView puts a small, vibrant screen atop a speaker base for taking video calls, beautifully displaying photos, and providing information at a glance with Apple's Siri AI voice assistant. The device's square shape makes it feel less imposing than larger smart displays like Google's Nest Hub Max or Amazon's Echo Show 11, and I can see it fitting nicely on my kitchen counter - though it might be a hair too big for my bedside table.

title: Elgato takes on DJI with a tiny wireless mic for creators on the go
summary: Elgato has introduced the Wave Go, a $99.99 wireless microphone for mobile creators that competes with DJI's Mic Mini. The pea-sized device weighs only seven grams and offers broadcast-quality audio with noise cancellation.
content:
The Wave Go microphone is around the size of an AirPod. | Image: Elgato	

Elgato already dominates the market for hardware built for creators that use powerful desktop PCs, and it's now turning its attention to creators on the go with its first wireless microphone. The $99.99 Wave Go clips onto your clothes just like DJI's Mic Mini, with hands-free recording for vlogging and content creation.
The Wave Go is tiny, about the size of an AirPod, so it disappears on camera and only weighs seven grams. Despite the tiny size, Elgato is promising "broadcast-quality" audio, with a condenser capsule that supports EQ shift, auto gain, and noise cancellation.
